author: SickProdigy
description: Post configurable new movie release announcements from TMDb to a Discord channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild movie release announcement settings and posted movie IDs. It does not persistently store user data or metadata.
install_msg: This cog contacts TMDb and stores guild announcement settings and posted movie IDs in Red Config. As the bot owner, set one shared TMDb API key with `[p]set api tmdb api_key,YOUR_KEY`. Users can then run `[p]movies <title>` or `[p]movie <title>`. To enable release announcements, choose a channel with `[p]movieset channel`, optionally set a notification role with `[p]movieset role`, then use `[p]movieset enable`.
name: MovieReleases
